# blow_moulding
# Baseline of buildCommodityRules — DO NOT hand-edit.
# Regenerate: npx tsx scripts/snapshot-commodity-rules.ts

### context: full
BLOW MOULDING COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  Lines marked UNDECIDED are yours to answer: nothing in the geometry settles them. Answer from the drawing, the photo or the part name, and say which you used.
  wallThicknessMm=3  [ray-cast mean wall over 400 samples — deterministic, use verbatim]
  materialId: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  partVolumeL: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  partWeightKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  flashWeightKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  process: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  subtype: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  barrierMultilayer: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  cavities: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  machineId: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  coolTimeFactorSPerMm2: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  blowTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  openCloseSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  mouldMaterial: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  mouldLife: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
  mouldCostGBP: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))

### context: degraded
BLOW MOULDING COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  Lines marked UNDECIDED are yours to answer: nothing in the geometry settles them. Answer from the drawing, the photo or the part name, and say which you used.
  wallThicknessMm: UNDECIDED — needs "What is the nominal wall thickness?" (Enter the nominal wall)
  materialId: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | PET Bottle Grade (1101))
